description: Calculate port-to-port ocean freight sea distance (statute miles and nautical miles), maritime routing through major canals and straits (Panama Canal, Suez Canal, Strait of Malacca, etc.), sailing transit days, and World Bank export/import customs clearance times across 155 world container ports and 188 countries. Accepts UN/LOCODEs (e.g. 'CNSHA', 'USHOU') or port/city names (e.g. 'Shanghai', 'Houston', 'Rotterdam', 'Los Angeles'). Does not count toward the estimate allowance.

destination_port.description: Destination container port name or UN/LOCODE (e.g. 'Los Angeles', 'USLAX', 'Houston', 'Newark').

origin_port.description: Origin container port name or UN/LOCODE (e.g. 'Shanghai', 'CNSHA', 'Rotterdam', 'Shenzhen').

name: estimate_ocean_transit
title: Estimate ocean freight transit time & sea distance
